title: Timeline cannot select a time
observed: Table cells have no selection control
expected: Choose a time while comparing zones
consequence: User returns to date field for each candidate
recommendation: Select cells and provide keyboard time steps
acceptance: Cell selection and 30-minute steps update all dates and preserve focus
retest: Fixed in tested scope; see retest-2026-10-21.md

title: Narrow timeline hides selected time
observed: Fixed label occupies 184 of 310 pixels and overlaps selected cell after reload
consequence: User must scroll to recover context
rationale: Core comparison is harder but scrolling is available
recommendation: Shorten labels and center within unobscured space
acceptance: Meeting cell remains fully visible after load and resize with a return-to-meeting control
retest: Fixed in tested scope; see retest-2026-10-21.md

title: Add chooses a city without search

acceptance: Add opens focused search and selected city appears in comparison
